description: We are Developers, a team passionate about Artificial Intelligence, coding, and space science. For NASA Space Apps Challenge 2026, we aim to build FlameGuard AI, an intelligent platform that analyzes NASA's microgravity combustion experiments and provides useful fire safety insights for future space missions. We welcome AI/ML developers, Python programmers, data analysts, web developers, UI/UX designers, and space science enthusiasts. Beginners are welcome too!
